teaser.en: Traps made from this shrub are said to be so strong that a caught animal rots before it can break free.
teaser.sw: Mitego inayotengenezwa kwa kichaka hiki inasemekana kuwa imara kiasi kwamba mnyama aliyenaswa huoza kabla hajaweza kujinasua.
teaser.dg: Nkugombwa kukala mihambo inayohendwa na chitsaka hichi ni mifu sana, hata nyama ariyegbwirwa anaola kabla ya kuweza kuchimbira.

summary.en: *Muoza nyama* is the wild honeysuckle tree, a shrub of forest edges with clusters of creamy, long-tubed flowers. It is used to make animal traps, and its name reflects their fearsome reputation.
summary.sw: *Muoza nyama* ni kichaka kiitwacho kwa Kiingereza *wild honeysuckle tree*, cha pembezoni mwa misitu, chenye vishada vya maua ya rangi ya krimu yenye mirija mirefu. Hutumika kutengeneza mitego ya wanyama, na jina lake linaakisi sifa ya kutisha ya mitego hiyo.
summary.dg: *Muoza nyama* ni *wild honeysuckle tree* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka cha kanda-kanda ya matsaka chenye mafungu ga maruwa ga rangi ya maziya, chila ruwa rina mrija mure. Nkuhumirwa kuhenda mihambo ya kugbwira nyama, na dzinare rinaonyesa sifwa za kuogofya za mihambo hiyo.

about.en: *Muoza nyama* is a shrub with clusters of creamy flowers, each with a long, slender tube that opens into narrow petals. The flowers resemble honeysuckle, which gives it its English name, and they are often scented in the evening.
about.sw: *Muoza nyama* ni kichaka chenye vishada vya maua ya rangi ya krimu, kila ua likiwa na mrija mrefu mwembamba unaofunguka kuwa petali nyembamba. Maua haya yanafanana na ya *honeysuckle*, ndiyo sababu ya jina lake la Kiingereza, na mara nyingi hutoa harufu nzuri jioni.
about.dg: *Muoza nyama* ni chitsaka chenye mafungu ga maruwa ga rangi ya maziya. Chila ruwa rina mrija mure na mwembamba, unaovuguka kuhenda vipande vyembamba vya ruwa. Maruwa higa ganahalana na *honeysuckle*, ndiyo sababu ya dzinare ra Chingereza, na mara nyinji ganalavya arufu nono dziloni.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in thicket.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vizito.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kahi ya vitsaka.

uses.en: It is used to make animal traps.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuhenda mihambo ya kugbwira nyama.

culture.en: The name means 'makes the animal rot'. Its traps are believed to be so strong that a trapped animal rots before it can escape.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'huozesha mnyama'. Mitego yake huaminika kuwa imara kiasi kwamba mnyama aliyenaswa huoza kabla hajaweza kutoroka.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'unaooza nyama', yani unaohenda nyama aole. Atu anaamini kukala mihamboye ni mifu sana, hata nyama ariyegbwirwa anaola kabla ya kuweza kuchimbira.

names.en: The Digo name is *muoza nyama*. In English it is the wild honeysuckle tree, and its scientific name is *Turraea floribunda*. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *muoza nyama*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *wild honeysuckle tree*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Turraea floribunda*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *muoza nyama*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild honeysuckle tree*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Turraea floribunda*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Another shrub used for catching animals (octopus)
reason.dg: *Mvua pweza*, chitsaka chanjina chinachohumirwa kugbwira nyama (pweza).

reason.sw: Mwamaji, wa familia ile ile ya mkangazi
